WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.category AS category_as_was, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.category, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, p.category_as_was, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, count(*) n
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT category_as_was FROM net_lines) p ON p.category_as_was = n.category_as_was
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 3,2;

SELECT 'cat' k, category || ' | ' || coalesce(subcategory,'') v, count(*) n, min(valid_from)::varchar mn, max(valid_to)::varchar mx FROM dim_product WHERE category ILIKE '%garden%' OR subcategory ILIKE '%light%' GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dupsales', 'dups', count(*) - count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), NULL, NULL FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dupret', 'dups', count(*) - count(DISTINCT return_line_id), NULL, NULL FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dupkey', 'receipt+line dups', count(*) - (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line)), NULL, NULL FROM fact_sales_line;

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 30;

SELECT min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(DISTINCT store_key), count(*), count(DISTINCT sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
UNION ALL

SELECT s.store_id = 900 AS is_web, o.status, p.category = 'Garden' AS garden, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-04-29' AND '2025-04-27' AND (s.store_id = 900 OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3;

),

    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(net_sales) v FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(net_sales) v FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, m.v mine, c.v control, m.v - c.v diff FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1;

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS category_as_was, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, 'Garden' AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN n.category_as_was = 'Garden' THEN n.net_sales END), 2) AS net_sales_as_was,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.category = 'Garden' THEN n.net_sales END), 2) AS net_sales_as_is
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2;
